## Here are this month’s highlights

- **Training gets a May power-up:** The first-ever Mega May Cyber Boost brings savings of up to 65% on Linux Foundation training, certifications, bundles, subscriptions, and instructor-led courses through May 20. Start with the full promotion or browse current training options — [Mega May Cyber Boost](https://hubs.la/Q04flmrR0) , [Linux Foundation Training](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/)

Read the latest releases and updates — [Kubernetes v1.36](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2026/04/22/kubernetes-v1-36-release/) , [ONNX v1.21.0](https://lfaidata.foundation/blog/2026/04/27/onnx-v1-21-0-released-introducing-opset-26-new-cumprod-operator-2-bit-type-support-and-more/) , [eBPF Security Update](https://ebpf.foundation/strengthening-ebpf-security-progress-on-audit-and-runtime-hardening/)

Mark your calendar — [Open Source Summit North America](https://events.linuxfoundation.org/open-source-summit-north-america/register/), [LF AI & Data Mini Summit](https://lfaidata.foundation/event/lf-ai-data-mini-summit-co-located-at-open-source-summit-north-america/), [AGNTCon + MCPCon Fall Events](https://events.linuxfoundation.org/aaif-events/)

## Linux Foundation Projects: Featured news

### Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)

- [goose](https://goose-docs.ai/) now ships built-in local inference powered by llama.cpp | Code never leaves the device. No Docker, no Ollama, no API key required. Models run fully offline, a meaningful step forward for teams working in sensitive environments or on air-gapped systems.
- goose v1.26 ships the Computer Controller extension |  rebuilt around Peekaboo, a macOS CLI tool that gives goose a see-then-click-then-type loop for desktop automation. It handles annotated screenshots, UI element identification, typing, scrolling, dragging, menus, and dialogs. goose can now automate workflows across desktop and web apps that don't expose clean APIs.[Read more on the goose blog >>](https://goose-docs.ai/blog/2026/04/29/computer-controller-peekaboo/) and[check out Peekaboo on GitHub >>](https://github.com/steipete/Peekaboo)
- A new community tool is tackling one of MCP's trickiest real-world problems | MCP Debugger was built by a developer who spent months working through authorization flows, security edge cases, and client behavior in production. Local tests passed. Smoke tests passed. But real agents connecting over HTTP exposed problems that were hard to find and harder to fix. MCP Debugger was built to close that gap.[Read the full blog post >>](https://aaif.io/?hsLang=en)
- Solo.io Open Sources AgentEvals For Production Agent Reliability | The project scores agent behavior from OpenTelemetry traces, giving teams a way to benchmark tool calls, trajectories, response quality, and regressions without re-running expensive LLM sessions. It supports offline and live evaluations, golden eval sets, built-in evaluators, CLI and web workflows, CI/CD use, and an MCP server for inspecting agent sessions from a conversation.[AgentEvals](https://aevals.ai/),[Solo.io](https://www.solo.io/press-releases/introducing-new-agentic-open-source-project-agentevals),[GitHub >>](https://github.com/agentevals-dev/agentevals)
- MCP Apps Go Mobile On Claude | Anthropic [shipped](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dendeli_mcp-claude-anthropic-share-7453193807279431681-cZN4/) MCP Apps support on Claude for iOS and Android, extending the interactive iFrame component pattern from desktop and web to the phone, allowing third-party tools to deliver branded, clickable UIs inside an agent conversation on mobile.
- Cloudflare Launches Agent Readiness Score For Websites | The new[isitagentready.com](http://isitagentready.com/) scanner audits whether sites expose the standards agents need to discover content, respect bot permissions, consume Markdown, call APIs, find MCP server cards, and support emerging commerce flows. Cloudflare also added the checks to URL Scanner and Radar, and made the scanner itself callable as a stateless MCP server, giving teams a concrete production path for making docs and services usable by agents.[Cloudflare >>](https://blog.cloudflare.com/agent-readiness/)
- Three flagship AGNTCon + MCPCon gatherings are coming up this fall | Tokyo (September 10–11), Amsterdam (September 17–18), and San Jose (October 22–23). These events bring together the organizations building production agentic systems to go beyond the proof of concept.[See the full 2026 events lineup >>](https://events.linuxfoundation.org/aaif-events/)

Its engineering ecosystem spans over 1,000 GitLab projects leveraging Terraform, AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Cron jobs, and Control-M workloads. Infosys was engaged to build a unified observability and governance platform using Prometheus and Grafana, consolidating fragmented tooling into a single pane of glass for metrics, compliance, and automated incident response.

The end-to-end customer journey depends heavily on multiple third-party systems, each operating its own monitoring or observability platform. Applications span Kubernetes and non-Kubernetes environments and expose interfaces through REST, SOAP, and command-line access, further complicating unified observability, increasing operational overhead and elongating incident timelines.

Remaining on a retired controller leaves critical infrastructure vulnerable to unpatched security risks. For one infrastructure engineer managing a cluster with over 60 complex Ingress resources, the challenge was clear: find a modern, enterprise-ready replacement that could be implemented without months of manual refactoring. This blog post explains how full migration validation was achieved in just 30 minutes by leveraging an AI agent and Higress, a cloud-native and AI-native API gateway founded by Alibaba that recently joined the CNCF Sandbox.

### Decentralized Identity Foundation (DIF)

### Agentic AI Foundation（AAIF）

- [goose](https://goose-docs.ai/) 現已內建由 llama.cpp 驅動的本機推論功能｜程式碼完全不會離開裝置。無須 Docker、Ollama 或 API 金鑰，模型可完全離線執行。對於在敏感環境或實體隔離系統中工作的團隊而言，這是意義重大的一步。
- goose v1.26 推出 Computer Controller 擴充功能 | 以 Peekaboo 為核心重新打造。Peekaboo 是一款 macOS 命令列工具，讓 goose 能以「先看、再點擊、接著輸入」的循環執行桌面自動化。它可處理含標註的螢幕截圖、辨識 UI 元素、輸入文字、捲動、拖曳、選單與對話框。現在，goose 已能在沒有完善 API 的桌面與網頁應用程式之間自動執行工作流程。[前往 goose 部落格閱讀更多 >>](https://goose-docs.ai/blog/2026/04/29/computer-controller-peekaboo/)以及[在 GitHub 查看 Peekaboo >>](https://github.com/steipete/Peekaboo)
- 全新社群工具著手解決 MCP 在真實環境中最棘手的問題之一 | MCP Debugger 的開發者花了數個月處理正式環境中的授權流程、安全性邊界案例與用戶端行為。區域測試通過了，冒煙測試也通過了，但真正的代理程式透過 HTTP 連線時，卻暴露出難以發現、更難修復的問題。MCP Debugger 正是為了彌補這道落差而打造。[閱讀完整部落格文章 >>](https://aaif.io/?hsLang=en)
- Solo.io 將用於正式環境代理可靠性的 AgentEvals 開源 | 此專案會根據 OpenTelemetry 追蹤資料評估代理程式的行為，讓團隊無須重新執行成本高昂的大型語言模型（LLM）工作階段，就能為工具呼叫、執行路徑、回應品質與回歸問題建立基準。它支援離線與即時評估、黃金評估集、內建評估器、命令列與網頁工作流程、CI/CD 應用，以及可透過對話檢視代理程式工作階段的 MCP 伺服器。[AgentEvals](https://aevals.ai/)、[Solo.io](https://www.solo.io/press-releases/introducing-new-agentic-open-source-project-agentevals)、[GitHub >>](https://github.com/agentevals-dev/agentevals)
- MCP Apps 登上行動版 Claude | Anthropic 已在 iOS 與 Android 版 Claude [推出](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dendeli_mcp-claude-anthropic-share-7453193807279431681-cZN4/) MCP Apps 支援，將桌面版與網頁版的互動式 iFrame 元件模式延伸至手機，讓第三方工具能在行動裝置的代理程式對話中提供帶有自身品牌、可供點選操作的使用者介面。
